transcript.en: Hello?
transcript.zh: 你好

transcript.en: Hi, it's Laura Carlton here.
transcript.zh: -你好，我是劳拉·卡瑞顿，

transcript.en: We've just arrived at the holiday flat, but I can't get the hot water and heating to work.
transcript.zh: 我刚到达假日公寓，但是我不能打开热水和暖气。

transcript.en: Oh right!
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: That's easy.
transcript.zh: 这很简单

transcript.en: Don't worry.
transcript.zh: 别担心

transcript.en: In the upstairs cupboard you'll find the water heater.
transcript.zh: 在楼上的柜橱里，你会找到热水器。

transcript.en: You'll see three main controls on the left at the bottom of the heater.
transcript.zh: 你会看到加热器底部的左面有3个主要的控制装置

transcript.en: The first one - the round one on the far left - is the most important one for the heating and hot water.
transcript.zh: 第一个，也就是最左边圆形的那个是加热和热水器最重要的控制装置。

transcript.en: It's the main control switch.
transcript.zh: 这是总控制开关

transcript.en: Make sure it's in the "on" position.
transcript.zh: 确定它位于“开”的位置

transcript.en: The switch itself doesn't light up, but the little square below will be black if the switch is "off".
transcript.zh: 开关不会变亮，但是如果开关位于“关”的位置，底下的小方块是黑色的。

transcript.en: That's probably what's happened - it's got switched off by mistake.
transcript.zh: 这可能就是原因，它可能不小心关掉了。

transcript.en: The middle one of these three controls - you'll see it's slightly larger than the first one - controls the radiators.
transcript.zh: 中间的那个，你可以看到它比第一个大一点，控制着暖气。

transcript.en: If you feel cold while you're there, and need the radiators on, this needs to be turned to maximum.
transcript.zh: 如果你在那里觉得冷，需要开暖气，你要把它开到最大。

transcript.en: The last of the three controls - the one on the right - is usually on about a number 4 setting, which for the water in the taps is usually quite hot enough.
transcript.zh: 三个控制装置的最后一个，位于右边的那个，通常开到4号档位，这时从水龙头出来的水通常足够热了。

transcript.en: Below the heating controls in the middle is a small round plastic button.
transcript.zh: 在加热控制装置下面的中间有一个小的圆形塑料按钮

transcript.en: If there isn't enough water in the pipes, sometimes the heat goes out.
transcript.zh: 如果管道里没有足够的热水，有时加热器就会熄火。

transcript.en: If this happens, you'll need to press the button to reset the heater.
transcript.zh: 如果出现这种情况，你需要按这个钮重启加热器。

transcript.en: Hold it in for about 5 seconds and the heater should come on again.
transcript.zh: 按住大约5秒，加热器就会重新开始。

transcript.en: Then there's a little square indicator under the third knob, that's kind of alarm light.
transcript.zh: 然后，在第三个把手下面的小方形指示器是一种报警灯。

transcript.en: It'll flash if you need to reset the heater.
transcript.zh: 如果你需要重启加热器，它会闪烁。

transcript.en: It sounds complicated.
transcript.zh: 听起来很复杂。

transcript.en: I'm sure you won't have any problems with it.
transcript.zh: 我相信你用起来不会有问题。

transcript.en: There should be some more instructions on the side of the heater.
transcript.zh: 加热器的旁边应该有更多的说明。

transcript.en: Call me back if you can't make it work.
transcript.zh: 如果你还弄不了就给我打电话。

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: While you on the phone, we haven't managed to find a few things we need, like extra pillows for the beds and some washing powder.
transcript.zh: 趁你现在在电话上，我们找不到一些需要的东西，例如床上富余的枕头和洗衣粉。

transcript.en: Is there any here?
transcript.zh: 这里有吗？

transcript.en: Pillows... yes, if you look in the cupboard, the large white one upstairs - to the left of the bathroom door - there should be four or five on the top shelf.
transcript.zh: 枕头，有的。如果你去看看楼上浴室门左边的白色大橱柜，在最上层的架子上应该有四、五个。

transcript.en: And if you want to do some washing, there is some powder for that...probably by the back door.
transcript.zh: 如果你想要洗衣服，洗衣粉可能在后门。

transcript.en: There is a kind of shelf there above the sink.
transcript.zh: 水槽上面有一个架子。

transcript.en: In fact, I'm sure there's some there, in a large blue box.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我肯定那里会有，在一个大的蓝盒子里。

transcript.en: You need about half a cup full for each wash.
transcript.zh: 洗一次你需要大约半勺。

transcript.en: And that reminds me, the spare key to the back door is hanging on a hook on the wall by the sitting room window.
transcript.zh: 这个提醒我了，后门的备用钥匙挂在客厅窗户旁边的墙上的挂钩上。

transcript.en: Please make sure to put it back when you've used it.
transcript.zh: 当你使完后请确保将它放回原处

transcript.en: The previous guests lost it in the garden and I had to get another one made.
transcript.zh: 之前的客人在花园里把它丢了，我不得不再做一把！

transcript.en: And if you have any trouble with the lamps, you'll find some spare bulbs in a large cardboard box.
transcript.zh: 如果灯有问题，在大纸盒里有备用灯泡。

transcript.en: It's on top of the washing machine with all kinds of useful things in it.
transcript.zh: 在洗衣机的上面有各种有用的东西

transcript.en: Oh, and another thing I forgot to mention when we last spoke...
transcript.zh: 我们上次谈话的时候，我还有一件事忘了说了...

transcript.en: Yes?
transcript.zh: 什么事？

transcript.en: I've left you a local map, so you'll be able to find your way around easily.
transcript.zh: 我给你留了一张本地地图，这样你在周边就不会迷路了。

transcript.en: It shows the whole area.
transcript.zh: 它涵盖了整个地区。

transcript.en: I put it in the top drawer of the chest under the TV in your bedroom.
transcript.zh: 我把它放在卧室电视机下面，箱子的第一个抽屉里了。

transcript.en: There is a whole file of local information in there too.
transcript.zh: 里面还有一堆当地信息的文件。

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。

transcript.en: What about visiting the town?
transcript.zh: 要是进城玩呢？

transcript.en: Can you give us any advice?
transcript.zh: 你能给我一些建议吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 可以。

transcript.en: You need to take the car.
transcript.zh: 你需要开车。

transcript.en: It's too far to walk from the flat really.
transcript.zh: 它离公寓真的很远，没法步行。

transcript.en: You have to pay to leave your car in all the car parks now I'm afraid...
transcript.zh: 恐怕你把车放在停车场还得交停车费。

transcript.en: I like the one that's by the station best and you can walk to the town center from there in five minutes.
transcript.zh: 我最喜欢车站旁边的那个，从那里走到城镇中心要花5分钟。

transcript.en: That's where all the best restaurants are.
transcript.zh: 那里有最好的餐馆。

transcript.en: But if you want a take-away, the Italian one does really good pasta and pizzas.
transcript.zh: 但是如果你想打包带走，有一家意大利餐厅做的意大利面和披萨很好吃。

transcript.en: Call 732281 for that one or 766119 for the Chinese.
transcript.zh: 那家的电话是732281，中国餐馆打766119。

transcript.en: They are both good and they'll both deliver to the flat.
transcript.zh: 两家都不错，而且都送外卖到公寓。

transcript.en: As for places to visit, yes, do go and see the railway museum.
transcript.zh: 至于参观的地方，是的，去看看铁路博物馆吧。

transcript.en: The exhibition is small but really good.
transcript.zh: 展览很小但是很棒。

transcript.en: It gets very crowded on Sundays, so I suggest you visit it on a quieter day, later in the week, but not on Thursdays, which is a market day - you won't find anywhere to park, and it's also the only day of the week when they're not open.
transcript.zh: 周末人很多，所以我建议你在安静的日子里去，每周靠后的几天，但是不要在赶集日，周四去。你将找不到停车位，而且这是他们一周唯一关门的一天！

transcript.en: Anything else?
transcript.zh: 还有什么要了解的吗？

transcript.en: Not for the moment.
transcript.zh: 暂时没有了。

transcript.en: Thanks！
transcript.zh: 谢谢！
